name: hello-unsupported-proto

graded_by.test: worker/tests/test_reattach.py — a hello whose proto_version the worker cannot speak is answered error unsupported_proto naming the session
core/internal/worker/version_test.go — unsupported_proto or unknown_cmd in answer to hello makes the session unreachable / protocol, never killed

description: Version (immortality §6.4, LOCKED: the core speaks N and N-1; a worker too old to speak a supported version is flagged unreachable/protocol, never silently killed). A restarted core reattaches a worker whose manifest names a version it does not know; it sends hello with its own, and the worker, unable to speak it, answers error unsupported_proto naming the session. The core marks the session unreachable / protocol — input refused (decision 5.38), shown with what the core has — and the operator drains it.
